reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 원단이 쫀쫀해서 착용감이 정말 좋아요! 너무 얇지도 두껍지도 않아서 지금 날씨엔 단독으로, 조금 더 추워지면 이너로 입히기 딱 좋을 것 같아요. 우리 강아지는 보통 올인원 입히면 불편해서 잘 못 움직이는데, 이 옷은 신축성이 좋아서 그런지 거부감 없이 잘 입어요ㅎㅎ 색감도 너무 예쁘고 활용도도 좋아서 다른 색상도 구입해보려구요 💛
reviews.content_en: The fabric is so stretchy and the fit is really comfortable! It's not too thin or too thick, so it's perfect to wear on its own with the current weather, and I think it'll be great as a base layer once it gets a bit colder. My pup usually has trouble moving around in onesies because they feel restrictive, but this one has such great elasticity that she wears it without any complaints ㅎㅎ The color is so pretty and it's so versatile that I'm thinking of getting it in other colors too 💛

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 이너로 입히려고 샀어요~ 근데 앞다리 기장이 생각보다 짧고, 배 부분도 생각보다 많이 노출되네요ㅠㅠㅋㅋ 조금 더 크게 입혀야하는 걸까요ㅠㅠ 그래도 가슴둘레랑 등길이는 괜찮은 것 같아요! 그리고 일단 소재가 톡톡하고 약~간 도톰한 감의 재질이여서 너무 덥지않게 입힐 수 있을 것 같아요^^ 색깔별로 쟁이고 싶네요ㅎㅎ 또 구매할게요~
reviews.content_en: I bought this as a base layer~ But the front leg length is shorter than I expected, and the belly area shows more than I thought ㅠㅠㅋㅋ Do I need to size up? ㅠㅠ But the chest circumference and back length seem okay! Plus the fabric is crisp and has a slightly puffy feel to it, so it should be comfortable to wear without being too hot ^^ I want to collect different colors ㅎㅎ I'll buy again~

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
어머 너무 이쁜 옷이네요^^  울 아기 입혔더니 너무 귀엽고 편해서 더욱 더 만족해요^^
우선 원단이 아주 고급스럽고 부드러워 아기들한테도 편안한 옷 같아요. 물론 디자인도 완벽합니다^^
울 아기 이쁜 사진 찍은거 올려보아요^^
reviews.content_en: Oh my, what a pretty outfit ^^ My baby looks so adorable and comfortable in it, so I'm even more satisfied ^^ First of all, the fabric is very high-quality and soft, making it a comfortable piece for my baby too. Of course, the design is perfect as well ^^ Let me share the cute photos I took of my baby ^^

reviews.name: 최****
reviews.content: 간절기랑 겨울에 이너로 입히기 좋아서 깔별로 가지고있는 제품인데 올인원이 있길래 주문해봤어요! 기존에 오트밀 긴발, 메론색 나시 제품 입혔는데 추울땐 긴팔이 좋아서 이번엔 올인원 주문했어요. 뒷모습 너무 귀엽고 원단도 도톰 쫀쫀해서 재재재 구매템입니다!
reviews.content_en: I've been collecting this product in different colors because it's great as a base layer for the transitional season and winter, so when I saw the onesie version, I ordered it! I had the oatmeal long-sleeve and melon-colored sleeveless versions before, but I preferred long sleeves for the cold, so I ordered the onesie this time. The back view is so cute and the fabric is thick and stretchy, so this is definitely a repeat purchase item!

reviews.name: 송****
reviews.content: 쫀쫀하고 사이즈도 좋아요..입을때 마니 불편하지안아요..부산가면서 작년에 구매한 바잇미패딩이라 입혔는데 따뜻하고 좋았어요..휴게소에서 어떤분이 이쁘다고 구매처를 물어봐서 바잇미라고 알려드렸어요^^
reviews.content_en: It's stretchy and the size is great..it's not inconvenient to wear..I wore a BITE ME padding that I bought last year while going to Busan, and it was warm and great..At a rest stop, someone asked where I got it because it looked so pretty, so I told them it was BITE ME ^^

reviews.name: 장****
reviews.content:
1살 실버푸들 3.4kg 평소 사이즈 M
2살 블랙말티푸 4.6kg 평소사이즈 ML,L
사이즈는 평소에 입히는 사이즈 그대로 하시면 될 것 같아요:)
요새 많이 추워져서 패딩안에 입을 올인원 제품찾다가 
바잇미찹쌀떡 올인원으로 구매해봤어요! 
이름 그대로 원단이 두께감있으면서 쫀쫀한 편이라 입고 활동 
하기에 괜찮은거 같아요! 
패딩류에 올인원은 겨울 한철입히거나 애매할 경우가 있는데 이 상품은 안에 이너로 입히고 패딩 입히실 분이나 실내에서 단독으로 입히실 분!! 추천합니다!
reviews.content_en:
1-year-old Silver Poodle 3.4kg, usually wears size M
2-year-old Black Maltipoo 4.6kg, usually wears size ML, L
I think you can just go with your usual size :)
Since it's gotten really cold lately, I was looking for an onesie to wear under a puffer jacket, so I got the BITE ME Glutinous Rice Cake onesie! True to its name, the fabric has good thickness while being stretchy, so it's comfortable to wear and move around in! Onesies under puffy jackets can be awkward in winter or when the weather is unclear, but this product is perfect for those who want to wear it as a base layer under a puffer jacket or wear it alone indoors!! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: 윤****
reviews.content: **목:27, 가둘:44(넉넉히), 체장:30, 4.7kg**미니비숑 라지 잘 맞아요!! 역시 찹쌀떡 시리즈는 다 좋네요. 소재도 좋고 라벨 프린팅 된 것도 좋구요. 모찌모찌한 소재라 쫙쫙 늘어나요. 이너로 입히기 딱이에요~^^. 작년이 오트밀 슬리브랑 슬리브리스 사서 잘 입었는데 이번엔 올인원으로 구매햐봤어요. 색상도 파스텔이라 더 맘에 들어요~~.
reviews.content_en: **Neck: 27, Chest: 44 (loose fit), Length: 30, 4.7kg** Mini Bichon, Large fits perfectly!! The Glutinous Rice Cake series is all great. The material is good and I love the printed label. The mochi-like fabric stretches nicely. Perfect as a base layer~^^ I bought the oatmeal sleeve and sleeveless versions last year and wore them well, and this time I tried the onesie. I like the pastel color even more~~

reviews.name: 유****
reviews.content:
3.4kg에 등길이 27 가둘38 말티푸예요
올인원은 등길이가 긴 말티푸에겐 참 사이즈 맞추기가 어려웠어요
M은 품은 맞는데 길이가 짧고 L는 길이는 맞는데 품은 크고~고민하다 낙낙하게 입히자해서 L로 주문했어요
등길이는 맞고 품은 약간 크기만 산책할때 편하게 안에 이너로 잘 입히고 있어요~톡톡하니 따뜻한 재질이예요
색감도 이삐네요^^
reviews.content_en:
3.4kg, back length 27, chest 38, Maltipoo
It was really difficult to find the right size onesie for my Maltipoo who has a long back
Size M fit the body but was short in length, and L fit the length but was roomy...I decided to just wear it loose and ordered L
The back length is right and the body is a bit roomy, but it's convenient to wear as a base layer during walks~ The fabric is crisp and warm
The color looks nice too ^^

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 올인원은 사이즈가 작거나 크면 불편해서 잘맞는 경우가 많지 않은데 올해는 사이즈가 아이에게 너무 편안하게 잘맞아서  좋아요 가격대비 품질도 좋고 만족합니다 색상도 이뻐요 참고로 6.7키로 아이예요
reviews.content_en: Onesies often don't fit well if the size is too small or too big, but this year the size fits my pup so comfortably, which is great! The quality is good for the price and I'm satisfied. The color is pretty too. Just for reference, my pup weighs 6.7kg

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 가슴둘레 42cm, 등길이 29cm, 몸무게 4kg 믹스견에게 딱 맞아요.효도의 상징 빨간내복 느낌입니다. 패딩 안에 입혔는데 편하게 잘 걸어요. 디자인도 예쁘고 매우 만족합니다.
reviews.content_en: Chest circumference 42cm, back length 29cm, weight 4kg - fits my mixed breed perfectly. It has that feeling of a red long underwear that symbolizes filial piety. I wore it under a puffer jacket and my pup walks comfortably. The design is pretty and I'm very satisfied.

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 브릭 먼저 입혀보고 넘 귀엽고 소재도 톡톡해서 멜론색상 재입고 기다렸다가 후다닥 구매했어요 :) 요즘 너무 추워서 패딩안에 이너로 입히고 있어요~ 잘 입힐게요❤️
reviews.content_en: I tried the brick color first and it was so cute and the fabric was so crisp that I waited and then rushed to buy it in melon color :) It's been so cold lately so I'm wearing it as a base layer under a puffer jacket~ I'll take good care of it ❤️

reviews.name: 한****
reviews.content:
새 상품 올라오자마자 구매했어요~
첫째랑 둘째 커플로 입히려고 브릭 색상 주문했는데, 진한 오렌지를 생각하고 있었는데 레드에요.. 레드에 오렌지 한방울 섞은 느낌입니다! 제가 생각했던 색상과 다르기도 하고, 화면 색상과 아예 달라서 아쉽지만 어차피 레드 올인원도 주문하고 싶었기 때문에 그냥 반품 안 하고 입히려구요~
그래도 소재는 엄청 쫀쫀, 모찌모찌 하고 도톰해서 따뜻할 것 같아요.
reviews.content_en:
I bought it right when the new product came out~
I ordered the brick color to match for my two pups, but I was thinking of a dark orange and it's red.. It feels like red with a drop of orange mixed in! It's different from what I imagined, and it's completely different from the screen color, which is a bit disappointing, but I was planning to order a red onesie anyway, so I'm just going to wear it without returning it~
But the material is super stretchy, mochi-like, and thick so it should be warm.

reviews.name: 여****
reviews.content:
저희집 11살 애기에게 쫀득한 찹쌀떡 티셔츠는 이미 색별로 모두 보유하고 있었으나!! 올인원이라니!! 올인원이 나왔다면 무조건 사야죠! 
5.6-7키로에 허리길고 다리길어서 옷이 매우 까다로운 아이인데 여기 xl사이즈는 찰떡이란 말이죠 아니나 다를까 xl하나만 구매했는데 딱맞아요 생식기부분도 시보리 처리 되어있어서 매우 맘에 듭니당 또 구매할게용!!!
reviews.content_en:
My 11-year-old baby already has the stretchy Glutinous Rice Cake t-shirt in every color!! But an onesie?! If they made an onesie, you have to buy it!
My pup is 5.6-7kg with a long waist and long legs, so finding clothes is very tricky, but the XL size here is perfect! Sure enough, I only bought one XL and it fits perfectly. The genital area is also sewn with elastic binding, which I really love, so I'll buy again!!!

reviews.name: 양****
reviews.content:
올인원입는건 별로 안좋아하는 아이인데  곧 털미용예정인데 그럼 추울듯하여 올인원도구입 털찐 4.6kg지금은L사이즈잘맏는데 미용후에 좀클듯하네요
그래도 찹쌀떡원단 따뜻할듯하고 이쁘네요
reviews.content_en:
My pup doesn't really like wearing onesies, but since grooming is coming up soon, I thought she'd be cold, so I got the onesie. She's a thick-coated 4.6kg and size L fits her well right now, but it might be a bit big after grooming.
But the Glutinous Rice Cake fabric should be warm and it looks pretty

reviews.name: 강****
reviews.content: 겨울에 입을 올인원이 필요해서 구매했는데 기대이상으로 면 제질도 너무 좋고 도톰하더라고요?! 안그래도 도톰한 올인원 필요했는데 눈오는날이나 한겨울에 이 올인원에 패딩 입히면 너무 따뜻할 것 같아요🩷 은은한 핑크라 검정패딩이나 카키패딩이나 어디에 입혀도 잘 어울려용(*´∀`)
reviews.content_en: I needed a winter onesie so I bought it, and it exceeded my expectations - the cotton quality is so good and it's really thick?! I needed a thick onesie anyway, and I think with this onesie and a puffer jacket on snowy days or deep winter, it'll be super warm 🩷 The subtle pink goes well with black puffer jackets or khaki puffer jackets no matter what ♡

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
올인원은 처음 입혀보는데 불편해하지도 않고 쫀쫀하니 좋아ㅏ요 
산책할때 추울까 구매해봤숩니다
평소에는 L로 입히는데 허리가 길어서 XL로 구매했는데 딱 맞네요
reviews.content_en:
It's my first time trying an onesie and my pup doesn't mind it and loves how stretchy it is~ I bought it because I was worried about the cold on walks
My pup usually wears L, but since she has a long waist, I got XL and it fits perfectly

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
쫀득쫀득 인절미같은 질감에 예쁜 색감 부드러운 촉감 대만족입니다. 재구매 했습니다 N차 구매 갈 것 같네요
단종 시키지 마시고 오래오래 계속 판매 해주세요 제바류ㅠ
reviews.content_en:
The stretchy mochi-like texture, pretty color, and soft feel are all wonderful. I've repurchased it. I think I'll be buying it many more times
Please don't discontinue it and keep selling it for a long time please 😭

reviews.name: 오****
reviews.content:
재입고 오예!! 바로 주문했어요 ㅎㅎ 
핑크 너무 예뻐요 !!!  칼라별로 다 사고싶은ㄷㅔ 몸이 더 커질까바 한개씩 구매하고 있어요ㅠㅠ
reviews.content_en:
It's back in stock, yes!! I ordered right away ㅎㅎ
The pink is so pretty!!! I want to buy all the colors but I'm buying one at a time because I'm worried about her growing bigger ㅠㅠ

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
예쁘고 맞는색깔로 구입해서 입혔어요
잘맞고 활동하기도 편해요
reviews.content_en:
I bought it in a pretty color that fits and my pup wears it well
It fits well and is comfortable to move around in

reviews.name: 서****
reviews.content: 진짜찹쌀떡쫀득쫀득그자체 가격대비너무좋아요 따숩따숩
reviews.content_en: The Glutinous Rice Cake fabric is truly stretchy and super good for the price. It's warm and cozy

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 털을 밀어서 조금 못생겻지만 잘 맞는 것 강아용 뒤에가 조금 찡길수 잇더라고여!! 그리고 저희강아지는 뒷다리부분이 좀 길어서 한번씩 접어줫어요!! 말티즈는 여쿨이라 퍼스널컬러에 맞게 하늘색 구매했는데 하늘색 색상이 너무 예쁘더라고요 ㅎㅎ
reviews.content_en: My pup's fur was shaved so it looks a bit less pretty, but it fits well. I noticed the back is a little tight! And my pup's hind legs are a bit long so I fold it up sometimes! My Maltese suits cool tones so I got sky blue to match her coloring, and the sky blue color is so pretty ㅎㅎ

reviews.name: 한****
reviews.content:
하늘색 먼저 입어보고
핏도 퀄리티도 좋아서 다른 색상도 추가로 구매했어요
색이 은은하니 아주 예뻐요!
reviews.content_en:
I tried the sky blue first and liked the fit and quality so much that I bought other colors too
The colors are subtle and really pretty!

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
후후 
원단이 너무 좋고 신축성이 정말 좋아서
아가들 입힐 때에도 고생하지않아요 !
reviews.content_en: Hehe, the fabric is so good and the elasticity is really great, so it's not hard to put on my pup!

reviews.name: 장****
reviews.content:
소재가 다른 올인원보다 두툼해서 강아지가 더

따뜻하게 입을 수 있을 것 같아요.

겨울용으로 정말 좋은 제품입니다!
reviews.content_en:
The material is thicker than other onesies so my pup can stay warmer.
It's a really great product for winter!

reviews.name: 유****
reviews.content:
쫀쫀한 원단, 예쁜 색상 모두 마음에 들어요
찹쌀떡 올인원 입고 산책 즐겁게 잘 다니고 있어요
reviews.content_en:
I love the stretchy fabric and the pretty colors
My pup wears the Glutinous Rice Cake onesie on walks and we're having a great time

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
왜 찹쌀떡이지 했는데 입히면서 신축성 보고 깨달았넹ㅅ 아… 이래서 찹쌀떡… 
애기가 옷 입을때 너무 신나서 반항 아닌 반항이 있는데 이게 신축성이 좋다보니까 입히는데 덜 힘들어요!
입고 나서는 쫀쫀하게 잘 맞아서 애가 찹살떡 같아요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 귀여워서 한참 보고 있었네요
reviews.content_en:
I wondered why it's called 'Glutinous Rice Cake' but I understood when I put it on and saw the elasticity. Ah... that's why it's called Glutinous Rice Cake...
My pup gets so excited about wearing clothes and usually puts up a bit of resistance, but because this has great elasticity, it's less of a struggle to put on!
Once it's on, it fits so snugly that my pup looks like a little glutinous rice cake ㅋㅋㅋㅋ It's so cute I couldn't stop looking

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
두벌씩 샀는데 잘 맞아요
원단이 쫀쫀해서 좋은 것 같네요
reviews.content_en:
I bought two and they fit well
The fabric is stretchy so it seems good

reviews.name: 조****
reviews.content:
재질좋고
6키로 말티푸 잘맞아요
reviews.content_en:
Good quality material
Fits my 6kg Maltipoo well

reviews.name: 곽****
reviews.content: 따뜻한 하늘색이어서 예쁘네요. 생각만큼 스판끼 낭낭한 매끈한 보들함은 아니고, 보드랍고 도톰한 면 감촉이에요. 두껍고 박음질 탄탄해서 좋아요!
